regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional two-narrative market: Oil & Gas Producers lead decisively (score 2.24, breadth 0.929) but are crowded, while Big Banks sit as a durable, trend-tagged challenger. Eight of sixteen themes are absolute-trend eligible; gate_helps is true, so trend discipline has historically reduced drawdown here. Gold, silver, base metals, uranium, REITs, telcos, rails and materials are below the eligibility gate — a defensively narrow tape with momentum concentrated in energy and banks.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Pipelines & Midstream (rank 3, breadth 1.0, durability 0.77, clean trend tag) confirms a leadership handoff from Oil & Gas Producers — the observable condition is Pipelines crossing Oil & Gas in 20-day relative strength while keeping the absolute-trend gate. If oil's crowding continues to cap it while oil-levered but less-crowded pipelines keep full breadth, the handoff is confirmed.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Highest momentum rank (2.24), broadest participation (breadth 0.929), eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and the rotation leader by a wide margin (1.393 over banks). Crowding (z=1.18) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Mixed Hurst tag and huge lead argue for keeping the lean but capping exposure.
theses.dissent: Crowded with mixed trend health (Hurst 'mixed'); energy leadership is reflexively fragile and a single supply-demand or policy shock can unwind the breadth fast.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO lags ZEB.TO by 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Second-rank (0.847), durable (0.71), and the only top-tier theme with a clean 'trend' Hurst tag and no crowding (z=0.44). Breadth is solid (0.857). The trend-gate edge is strongest on durable, non-crowded trend leaders, which fits banks better than crowded, mixed-Hurst oil.
theses.dissent: Banks are rate-sensitive; a hard-landing or credit-cycle turn hits financials before the trend-gate can de-risk, and the momentum gap to oil is wide (1.393).

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 4% over any rolling 10-day window before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Uranium & Nuclear
theses.thesis: Bottom rank (-1.757), zero breadth, below the absolute-trend eligibility gate (durability_bar only 0.22), mixed Hurst and no proxy ETF. The gate's only validated edge is shake-out avoidance — this theme is already in a shake-out state.
theses.dissent: Uranium has a structural supply-demand story that can re-rate independently of TSX sector momentum; low valuation could attract contrarian flow.

falsifier.text: A Canadian uranium producer basket gains 10% from here on sustained volume before the 30-day check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
